in_hebrew.name: Gessner
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Germanic: Spear Bearer
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gessner הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German name 'Gisilheri', composed of 'gisil' meaning 'pledge, hostage' and 'heri' meaning 'army, host'. The name Gessner can be interpreted as 'Spear Bearer' or 'Pledge Army'.
